name: week
title: The grain book this week
subtitle: Loads, contracts closing, growers to pay and buyers to chase

sections.title: Loads over the weighbridge in the last 7 days
sections.sql: select ticket, delivered_on as date, case when side = 'receival' then 'in' else 'out' end as in_out, org as grower_or_buyer, contract, site, grade, net_t as tonnes from delivery_values where delivered_on > current_date - 7 order by delivered_on desc, ticket desc

sections.title: Contracts whose window has closed short
sections.sql: select number, org as with, grade, tonnes, delivered_t as delivered, short_of_tolerance_t as short, delivery_to as window_closed, days_past_window as days_ago from contract_book where days_past_window > 0 order by days_past_window desc

sections.title: Delivery windows closing in 14 days
sections.sql: select number, org as with, grade, open_t as still_to_come, delivery_to as window_closes from contract_book where status = 'open' and delivery_to between current_date and current_date + 14 and open_t > 0 order by delivery_to

sections.title: Loads received and not settled
sections.sql: select ticket, delivered_on as date, org as grower, contract, grade, net_t as tonnes, to_char(value_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as value, pay_by, days_since from unsettled_receivals order by delivered_on

name: position
title: Position and prices
subtitle: Stock plus open purchases less open sales, against today's cash prices

sections.title: The position
sections.sql: select p.commodity, p.grade, p.season, p.stock_t as in_store, p.open_purchase_t as bought_to_come, p.open_sale_t as sold_to_go, p.net_t as net, to_char(lp.cents_per_t / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as cash_price from positions p left join latest_prices lp on lp.grade_id = p.grade_id and lp.season = p.season order by p.commodity, p.grade

sections.title: In store by site
sections.sql: select site, commodity, grade, tonnes from inventory where tonnes <> 0 order by site, commodity, grade

sections.title: Cash prices posted
sections.sql: select commodity, grade, season, site, posted_on, to_char(cents_per_t / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as per_tonne from latest_prices order by commodity, grade

name: money
title: Money in and out
subtitle: What growers are owed and what buyers owe

sections.title: RCTIs issued and not paid
sections.sql: select number, grower, issued_on, due_on as pay_by, to_char(pay_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990.00') as to_pay from settlement_totals where status = 'issued' order by due_on

sections.title: Buyers, against their credit limit
sections.sql: select name as buyer, to_char(owing_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as invoiced, to_char(overdue_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as overdue, to_char(uninvoiced_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as not_invoiced, to_char(credit_limit_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as credit_limit, case when credit_limit_cents is not null and owing_cents + uninvoiced_cents > credit_limit_cents then 'OVER LIMIT' else '' end as flag from buyer_exposure where owing_cents > 0 or uninvoiced_cents > 0 order by overdue_cents desc

sections.title: Sale invoices overdue
sections.sql: select number, buyer, issued_on, due_on, days_overdue, to_char((total_cents - paid_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990.00') as owing from invoice_totals where status = 'issued' and days_overdue > 0 order by days_overdue desc
